name: Two VISIBLE curl terminals on ashu-mac
description: Open two real Terminal.app windows on the remote macOS agent 'ashu-mac' (via osascript) and run a curl in each, so an operator sitting at the Mac visibly watches the terminals run. TRADE-OFF: cap.shell_exec captures osascript's result (the Terminal tab handle), NOT the curl response. The HTTP responses are only visible on-screen in the Terminal windows, not returned to the server. For headless execution that returns both responses to the server, use examples/09-agent-curl-terminals instead.
rationale: Visible variant. Plain cap.shell_exec runs a headless background subprocess (no window). To make a terminal VISIBLY open on the agent's desktop, we shell out to osascript, which drives Terminal.app to open a window and run the curl there. Requires the macOS agent to be running in a logged-in GUI session (the default unless AAKAAR_AGENT_HEADLESS=1).

argv: tell application "Terminal" to do script "curl -sS --max-time 30 https://httpbin.org/get"
tell application "Terminal" to do script "curl -sS --max-time 30 https://httpbin.org/uuid"
